canonicalIdentity.environmentIdentity: Resolve activeEnvironmentContract from shared/chain-registry.js and activeEnvironmentTokenId from the configured collection mirror; fall back to mainTokenId only when the collection's mirror strategy is IDENTITY.
evidence: WF-MIG.4 reconciled all 66 items by normalized collection, mainnet contract, and main token ID.
WF-MIG.3 confirmed hidden .token-id-number text and list/pane membership are runtime identity inputs.

collections.orderStrategy: Explicit presentationOrder imported from the observed Token ID ascending order 0-12.
Explicit presentationOrder imported from the observed Token ID ascending order 0-30.
Explicit presentationOrder imported from sparse main token IDs ascending; active connected rendering may sort mapped active IDs numerically without changing stable identity.
Store the observed initial order 4,3,2,1,0 explicitly because all five Mint Dates are equal and Webflow's tie break is unavailable.

fields.name: collectionKey
validationRules: Must resolve exactly one collection record.
Must agree with source collection, output list, and route family.

fields.name: collectionDisplayName
validationRules: Preserve exact pluralization and case, including THE 419 SCRIPTs and INTRODUCTIONs.

fields.name: collectionRowLabel
validationRules: Preserve HIC ET NUNC for HEN and INTRODUCTIONS for INTRODUCTIONS.
Must not be used as contract identity.

fields.name: mainnetContract
fields.derivationRule: Lookup collections[collectionKey] in shared/chain-registry.js mainnet slot.
validationRules: Must be a non-placeholder KT1 address.
Must equal the collection-level migration record.

fields.name: activeEnvironmentContract
fields.derivationRule: Lookup collections[collectionKey] in the configured testnet slot, which currently means Shadownet.
validationRules: Registry slot remains testnet while configured environment remains Shadownet.
Must not enable or substitute mainnet.

fields.name: mainTokenId
validationRules: Unique within collectionKey.
SCRIPT 0-12, CANAAN 0-30, HEN exact 17 sparse IDs, INTRODUCTIONS 0-4.
Must never be inferred from array or DOM position.

fields.name: activeEnvironmentTokenId
fields.derivationRule: Use shared/chain-registry.js mirrors[collectionKey][mainTokenId] when configured; otherwise use mainTokenId only for an IDENTITY strategy.
fields.targetSource: Build/runtime derivation from the chain registry
validationRules: All 17 HEN sparse main IDs map bijectively to active IDs 0-16.
All five INTRODUCTION IDs map explicitly.
No silent fallback when an explicit-map entry is missing.

fields.name: title
validationRules: Preserve exact Unicode, punctuation, case, slashes, apostrophes, and leading zeros.
Must match the existing title map during migration.

fields.name: name
fields.derivationRule: name = title while route compatibility records are generated.
validationRules: Must equal title for all 66 imported records unless a later schema decision introduces a distinct semantic.

fields.name: editions
validationRules: Import exact value for all 66 items.
Must be greater than zero.
Must not be relabeled as circulating or live chain supply without separate evidence.
unresolved: The business/chain semantic of Editions is not independently established.

fields.name: imagePath
validationRules: Local file must exist.
Acquisition manifest must record source URL, file ID, content hash, MIME type, dimensions, and equivalence result.
HEN path lookup must use mainTokenId with an explicit adapter to any active mirror-indexed source.
unresolved: Content equivalence between Webflow media and local candidates is not yet verified.

fields.name: imageAlt
currentSources: Webflow image alt values, currently null
validationRules: Never omit the alt attribute.
Use an explicit empty string during parity migration where current intent is unknown.
Any descriptive replacement requires accessibility review and must not duplicate adjacent title text unnecessarily.
unresolved: Meaningful-versus-decorative intent has not been established per asset.

fields.name: mintDate
currentSources: Webflow mint-date for 35 SCRIPT, HEN, and INTRODUCTION items
validationRules: Import all 35 exact timestamps.
CANAAN must use null because the field does not exist there.
Do not derive presentation order solely from equal dates.
unresolved: Mint Date semantics are not independently matched to chain mint time.

fields.name: objktRouteFamily
validationRules: SCRIPT, HEN, and INTRODUCTIONS retain their distinct current/legacy route families.
CANAAN remains null.
unresolved: Live marketplace validity was not independently browsed.

fields.name: objktUrl
fields.derivationRule: Apply objktRouteFamily to mainnetContract and mainTokenId; prepend the preserved marketplace origin.
validationRules: All 35 derived URLs must exactly equal the audited Webflow values before cutover.
Do not normalize legacy route forms.
unresolved: External marketplace route availability is a validation requirement, not a canonical-data dependency.

fields.name: slug
validationRules: Import all 66 exact values.
Unique within routeFamily.
Must not be regenerated from title; CANAAN token 3 is the known counterexample.

fields.name: presentationOrder
validationRules: Unique and contiguous within each generated list context.
INTRODUCTIONS preserves observed 4,3,2,1,0 initial order explicitly.
Order must not define identity.
unresolved: Webflow's equal-date INTRODUCTION tie break remains unavailable and is intentionally replaced by explicit order.

fields.name: acidValue
fields.derivationRule: ceil(100 / editions) for SCRIPT and CANAAN; null for HEN and INTRODUCTIONS.
validationRules: All 44 values and 75 current quantity-row occurrences must match the audited values.
Transaction total remains acidValue multiplied by selected quantity.

fields.name: collectionDisplayMetadata
validationRules: May contain pane key, list key, empty-state copy, and row-family key only.
Must not duplicate contract authority or runtime eligibility rules.

fields.name: publicationMetadata
validationRules: All 66 migration inputs are non-draft and non-archived with publishedOn present.
Runtime generation includes only explicitly enabled canonical items.

fields.name: webflowProvenance
validationRules: Record collection ID, item ID, image file ID/source URL, snapshot generation time, and source artifact.
Must not be required by deployed runtime.

migrationImports.verification: Content hash, MIME, dimensions, animation, and visual equivalence

derivedValues: objktUrl from collection route strategy, mainnet contract, and main token ID
activeEnvironmentTokenId from mirror strategy and shared/chain-registry.js
omittedValues: Webflow CMS ordering as an implicit runtime service after explicit presentationOrder is imported
Webflow form success/failure wrappers where controls are non-submitting
Webflow-generated element IDs and repeated form/control IDs
Webflow draft/archive workflow as a deployed runtime dependency
validationRules: Exactly four collections and 66 enabled token records.
Physical Webflow schema coverage is 10 SCRIPT + 8 CANAAN + 9 HEN + 9 INTRODUCTIONS = 36 fields; every field occurrence maps to one global field decision above.
Stable keys and route paths are unique.
All exact titles, slugs, editions, dates, labels, IDs, route families, and observed orders match migration evidence.
All referenced assets exist locally and no canonical runtime record contains a Webflow URL.
Generated list membership is HEN/INTRODUCTIONS/CANAAN on Drops and SCRIPT/CANAAN in the correct Exchange panes.
No transaction or selection identity is derived from presentation order or DOM index.
Generated output is byte-deterministic for identical source, dependency lockfile, and build environment.

Preserve exact values and provenance; do not expose a new meaning.
Require acquisition and hash/pixel verification before switching asset URLs.
Preserve explicit empty-alt behavior in the parity pass and perform an accessibility review before intentional copy changes.
Introduce and validate an explicit main-ID-to-local-asset adapter; never key mainnet HEN records by 0-16 implicitly.
Capture published HTTP/DOM baselines during WF-MIG.7 and freeze content before final import.
Default to generated equivalent-empty 200 routes for all exact slugs, subject to published response/status verification.
